newsitem.title: POLAND: KPW clears Polish brewer Brok for public trade.
newsitem.headline: KPW clears Polish brewer Brok for public trade.

text.p: The Polish Securities Commission (KPW) has cleared for public trade the initial public offering of brewer Brok SA, the KPW said in a statement on Wednesday.

Brok President Wieslaw Szopinski told a news conference on Wednesday that the firm, which seeks a parallel market listing in late July or early August, hoped to gain about seven million zlotys from the issue of 287,500 shares.
The firm's 1,725,000 existing shares have also been approved for trade. @
